description: Extension of esm-hist-GHG to 2100 with fossil fuel CO2 emissions and other well-mixed greenhouse gases following the Medium scenario and other forcings fixed at pre-industrial levels.  CO2 evolves interactively.
branch_information: Continue from esm-hist-GHG at the end of 2035 (branch at 2036-01-01), retaining the corresponding ensemble member name.
